tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and five mixed-response observations leave genuine identifiability ambiguity among smooth concave, substrate-inhibited, and branch/siphon mechanisms. Acquire the available open-branch discriminating probe before committing to a stationary model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth stationary model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not identify the competing nonlinear response families, and the recalled siphon note flags a possible high-gradient branch.
More dense trajectory data costs more and is less targeted than a probe designed to distinguish the open branch.
It is explicitly irrelevant and must not be purchased.
The source note recommends it above s_grad 2.36, but it is not listed in the available probe menu.
